up: Retrieve activity records for the human protein target CHEMBL1936 (Mast/stem cell growth factor receptor Kit) where activities have a standard relation '=' and a non-null pChEMBL value, using the IC50 standard type. For each matching activity, return the assay's ChEMBL ID (assay_chembl_id), the target's type (target_type), the target's tax_id, the compound's canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles), the molecule's ChEMBL ID (molecule_chembl_id), the activity's standard type (standard_type), and the pChEMBL value (pchembl_value). Include only rows where the standard relation is exactly '=' and pchembl_value is not null. Do not filter on assay confidence, organism, or target type. Order the final result set by molecule_chembl_id in ascending order, then by assay_chembl_id in ascending order, and return up to the first 1000 rows.
sql:
WITH filtered_activities AS (
  SELECT
    a.activity_id,
    a.standard_relation,
    a.pchembl_value,
    a.molregno,
    a.assay_id,
    a.type AS activity_type,
    a.standard_type
  FROM activities a
  WHERE
    a.standard_type = 'IC50' AND
    a.standard_relation = '=' AND
    a.pchembl_value IS NOT NULL
), joined_target AS (
  SELECT
    fa.activity_id,
    fa.molregno,
    fa.assay_id,
    fa.pchembl_value,
    fa.standard_type,
    fa.standard_relation,
    a.assay_id AS assay_id,
    t.pref_name AS target_pref_name,
    t.tid AS target_tid,
    a.type AS target_type,
    t.tax_id AS tax_id,
    a.assay_id AS assay_id,
    a.assay_id AS assay_id
  FROM filtered_activities fa
  JOIN activities a ON fa.activity_id = a.activity_id
  JOIN target_dictionary t ON a.tid = t.tid
  WHERE t.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936'
),
joined_structures AS (
  SELECT
    js.molregno,
    js.canonical_smiles,
    js.molregno AS molregno_struct,
    js.standard_inchi_key
  FROM compound_structures js
  WHERE js.molregno IN (SELECT DISTINCT molregno FROM joined_target)
)
SELECT
  a.assay_id AS assay_chembl_id,
  t.target_type,
  t.tax_id,
  s.canonical_smiles,
  t.molregno AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM joined_target a
LEFT JOIN joined_structures s ON a.molregno = s.molregno
WHERE s.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY molecule_chembl_id ASC, assay_chembl_id ASC
LIMIT 1000;
